notes: Six-hour agent timeout (override_timeout_sec=21600) on the fixed-QEMU TB2.1 snapshot; a modified evaluation, not a leaderboard-eligible configuration.

bench-run cohort on HF Jobs (Harbor 077c5ec6) with the published fast-agent-mcp 0.10.46 wheel; GPT-5.6 Luna (high reasoning) through the OpenAI Responses API with an API key, flex service tier. Zero whole-trial retries; fast-agent's own provider retries apply.

Three infrastructure failures (a sandbox connection error, an HF exec-stream drop, a test-upload error on train-fasttext) were rerun as replacements; the train-fasttext rerun hit another stream drop and was rerun again. The originals are kept as evidence; the run as first launched scored 338/445.

Cost is Harbor's recorded cost at the cohort's configured OpenAI flex rates (card-packs pricing catalog 2026-10-11.1, rules gpt-5.6-luna-flex-short / -long: $0.10 / $0.01 / $0.125 / $0.60 per million input / cached / cache-write / output tokens; $0.20 / $0.02 / $0.25 / $0.90 above 272k context). One trial has model calls that reported no usage, so the total is a lower bound.
